essence: Therefore initiation is established as the primary means leading to both worldly enjoyment and liberation.
Therefore initiation directs each candidate to the domain of the enjoyments he seeks.
Therefore fitness and inclination determine the placement that leads to success through mantra power.
Therefore initiation is taught as a means that extends beyond enjoyment to higher aims.
Therefore initiation is necessary for Shaiva yoga but its effect is not limited to yoga eligibility alone.
